title: Another Life
lyrics:
[00:07.59]If I can't let you go, will darkness divide?
[00:13.76]For the fiction of love is the truth of our lies
[00:19.52]We were playing for keeps, but we both knew the cost
[00:25.48]Now the only way out's in your heart-shaped box
[00:34.29]But I hate that it seemed you were never enough
[00:40.23]We were broken and bleeding, but never gave up
[00:46.13]And I hate that I made you the enemy
[00:52.10]And I hate that your heart was the casualty
[00:58.09]Now I hate that I need you
[01:12.87]As we rest here alone like notes on a page
[01:18.82]The finest to compose could not play our pain
[01:24.76]With a candle through time, I can still see your ghost
[01:30.58]But I can't close my eyes, for it
[01:34.84]For it is there where you haunt me most
[01:38.01]Where you haunt me most
[01:39.86]I hate that it seemed you were never enough
[01:45.48]We were broken and bleeding, but never gave up
[01:51.43]And I hope that I sing through your memory
[01:57.36]As we echo through time in the melody
[02:03.22]Now I hate that I need you
[02:07.79]And I hear you now when you said, "It hurt"
[02:13.58]"But it had to fall, fall apart to work"
[02:19.45]As I see you now in what's left of me
[02:25.51]Is it too late to plead insanity?
[02:31.67]I won't let go
[02:32.85]'Cause I hate that it seemed you were never enough
[02:38.74]You were broken and bleeding in the name of love
[02:44.69]And I hope that we meet in another life
[02:51.05]I hope that we meet in another life
[02:56.61]I don't hate that I need you (I don't hate that I need you)
[03:02.54]I don't hate that I need you (I don't hate that I need you)
[03:08.40]I don't hate that I need you
